failures.resulting_state: The write transaction is rolled back; no partial record is persisted and no evaluation job is created.
failures.retry: Retry after correcting the data or database; a documented idempotency policy controls duplicate identifiers.
failures.trigger: Serialization or commit fails while saving an experience, memory, or feedback update.

failures.resulting_state: Neither the lesson nor the derived memory is persisted; a previously persisted raw experience is retained.
failures.retry: Evaluation may be retried; the caller controls duplicate identifiers.
failures.trigger: Inserting or committing the lesson-and-derived-memory pair fails.

failures.resulting_state: Only the read fails, carrying the table, record, and field context; persisted state is unchanged.
failures.retry: Retry after repairing or migrating the stored data.
failures.trigger: Stored JSON, enum, UUID, or timestamp data is malformed when loaded.

failures.resulting_state: The pre-migration schema and records are preserved through rollback.
failures.retry: Re-run initialization after resolving the cause; forward migration is idempotent.
failures.trigger: A schema migration step or its commit fails.

failures.retry: Initialize before closing, or construct a new store after close.
failures.trigger: A public operation is invoked on a closing or closed store.

failures.resulting_state: The persisted experience is retained; the job reaches a failure terminal state and is reported by flush() or shutdown(drain).
failures.retry: The caller may retry the specific operation identified by the failure context.
failures.trigger: Evaluation, embedding, rule generation, or reflection fails for a background job.

failures.resulting_state: No new job or write is created.
failures.retry: Construct a new Learner; the shut-down instance is not reopened.
failures.trigger: Background_Job work is submitted during or after shutdown.

failures.retry: Retry with a valid configuration value.
failures.trigger: An invalid limit, prompt budget, or configuration value is supplied.

failures.resulting_state: No Experia state changes before the error, which names the required extra.
failures.retry: Install the named extra and invoke the feature again.
failures.trigger: An optional feature is invoked without its installation extra.

failures.retry: Available only after a release marks the feature implemented.
failures.trigger: A planned placeholder adapter or integration is constructed or invoked.

failures.resulting_state: Neither the external request nor its log metadata is emitted, and caller-provided values are left unchanged.
failures.retry: Retry after fixing the sanitizer or data; automatic bypass is not allowed.
failures.trigger: The configured sanitizer fails before an external sink or log emission.

operations.call_order: Await once after constructing the store and before any read or write; Learner never calls it implicitly.
operations.idempotence: Safe to await more than once; an already-open connection is reused and forward-only migration is a no-op at the current version.
operations.pending_jobs: Creates no Background_Job; no background work is pending on return.
operations.postconditions: Opens the SQLite connection, enables foreign keys, best-effort WAL, and migrates the schema forward to the current version before returning.
operations.title: Store initialization

operations.call_order: Await after record() or remember() to complete outstanding evaluation, embedding, rule-generation, and reflection work; returns a FlushReport.
operations.idempotence: Repeatable; each call opens a new cutoff generation, and a call with no outstanding work returns an empty report.
operations.pending_jobs: Every Background_Job in the flush snapshot is terminal on return; jobs accepted after the cutoff stay pending and are unaffected.
operations.postconditions: Captures a cutoff snapshot of every non-terminal Background_Job accepted before the call plus its causal descendants, returns only after each reaches a terminal state, and raises a typed EvaluationFailure that aggregates downstream failures while retaining persisted experiences.
operations.title: Learner.flush()

operations.call_order: Await once when the Learner is finished to stop accepting new Background_Job work; select the drain or cancel policy; returns a ShutdownReport. Learner.aclose() wraps this and can also close the store.
operations.idempotence: Idempotent; the first caller selects the policy and concurrent or later callers await the same completion. The Learner is not reopened after shutdown; construct a new instance.
operations.pending_jobs: Every accepted Background_Job is terminal on return; submissions during and after shutdown are rejected with a typed LifecycleError.
operations.postconditions: Atomically closes submissions and, under drain, awaits every accepted job or, under cancel, requests cancellation of every non-terminal job and awaits its terminal transition; drain surfaces an aggregated EvaluationFailure only after all jobs are terminal.
operations.title: Shutdown operation (Learner.shutdown())

operations.call_order: Await when the store owner is finished, after any Learner.shutdown(); Learner.aclose(close_store=True) performs this ordering. Learner.shutdown() does not close the caller-owned store implicitly.
operations.idempotence: Idempotent; concurrent callers await one close completion, and calls after the first successful close are no-ops with persisted data unchanged.
operations.pending_jobs: Closing the store does not manage Learner Background_Job work; drain or cancel it with Learner.shutdown() or flush() first so no evaluation job races the connection close.
operations.postconditions: Waits for in-flight store operations to drain, closes the SQLite connection, and marks the store closed; later store operations raise a typed StorageError with operation "lifecycle".
operations.title: Store close (SQLiteStore.close())
